commands.name: capture_game_view
commands.description: Render the game view to a PNG. source=camera (default) renders a camera and misses Screen Space - Overlay UI; source=screen captures the composited backbuffer incl. overlay canvases (Play Mode only). Returns it inline as base64, unless save_path is set (path-only result; pass include_inline_image=true to get both).

parameters.name: width
parameters.description: Output width in px (default 1280; capped 4096).

parameters.name: height
parameters.description: Output height in px (default 720; capped 4096).

parameters.name: camera
parameters.description: Optional camera name (source=camera only); defaults to Camera.main, else the first enabled camera.

parameters.name: save_path
parameters.description: Optional project-relative path to write the PNG (e.g. Screenshots/foo.png). When set, the result omits the inline base64 image unless include_inline_image=true.

parameters.name: include_inline_image
parameters.description: Also return the image inline as base64 when save_path is set (default false: path-only result). Only meaningful together with save_path.

parameters.name: max_resolution
parameters.description: Cap on the inline image's longest edge (e.g. 512). Only applies when an inline image is returned (no save_path, or save_path + include_inline_image=true); the save_path file keeps the requested resolution.

parameters.name: source
parameters.description: What to capture: 'camera' (default) renders a camera (misses Screen Space - Overlay UI); 'screen' captures the composited game view incl. overlay canvases (HUDs), Play Mode only.

commands.name: clear_console
commands.description: Clear the captured log buffer and the Unity Editor console.

schema.title: clear_console
schema.description: Clear the captured log buffer and the Unity Editor console.

commands.name: console
commands.description: Get captured Unity console output (Editor or Player; supports tail, level filtering, and follow via a cursor)

parameters.name: tail
parameters.description: Maximum number of most-recent entries to return

parameters.name: level
parameters.description: Minimum severity to include: log | warn | error

parameters.name: since
parameters.description: Cursor: only return entries newer than this seq. Use the 'cursor' from a previous response to follow.

parameters.name: since_session
parameters.description: Session the 'since' cursor came from: pass the 'session' from a previous response. A cursor from another session is refused and the tail returned with reset=true.

commands.name: screenshot
commands.description: Capture the Scene or Game view as a PNG and return its file path

parameters.name: view
parameters.description: Which view to capture: 'game' (default) or 'scene'

parameters.name: output
parameters.description: Output PNG path (absolute, or relative to the project root). Defaults to a timestamped file under <project>/Temp/pipeline-screenshots/.

parameters.name: width
parameters.description: Output width in pixels. 0 (default) uses the view camera's current width.

parameters.name: height
parameters.description: Output height in pixels. 0 (default) uses the view camera's current height.
